crotch_l.method: highest z at which the thigh is a separate horizontal-section loop

crotch_r.method: highest z at which the thigh is a separate horizontal-section loop

thigh_axis_l.method: line through centroids of sections perpendicular to the thigh, knee+8 cm .. crotch-3 cm

shank_axis_l.method: line through centroids of sections perpendicular to the distal shank, z 14..40 cm (below the calf belly)

knee_l.A_method: centroid of the minimum-area section across the knee (perpendicular to the mean thigh/shank axis)
knee_l.B_method: centroid of the section at the patellar flattening (minimum slope of the anterior contour)

ankle_l.A_method: distal-shank axis at the anterior ankle crease (maximum curvature of the anterior contour)
ankle_l.B_method: distal-shank axis at the Achilles concavity (most anterior point of the posterior contour above the heel)
ankle_l.note: no malleolar relief in the source: the medial/lateral extents show no malleolus bump, so the talocrural axis obliquity is unsupported

heel_l.method: area-weighted posterior-most surface band of the sole region (z<3 cm)

hip_l.A_method: thigh axis extended to the level of the inguinal fold (first local minimum of the anterior contour above the crotch)
hip_l.note: femoral head is internal and the source has no trochanteric relief; the inguinal-fold level on the soft-tissue thigh axis and the frozen value are the only alternatives

thigh_axis_r.method: line through centroids of sections perpendicular to the thigh, knee+8 cm .. crotch-3 cm

shank_axis_r.method: line through centroids of sections perpendicular to the distal shank, z 14..40 cm (below the calf belly)

knee_r.A_method: centroid of the minimum-area section across the knee (perpendicular to the mean thigh/shank axis)
knee_r.B_method: centroid of the section at the patellar flattening (minimum slope of the anterior contour)

ankle_r.A_method: distal-shank axis at the anterior ankle crease (maximum curvature of the anterior contour)
ankle_r.B_method: distal-shank axis at the Achilles concavity (most anterior point of the posterior contour above the heel)
ankle_r.note: no malleolar relief in the source: the medial/lateral extents show no malleolus bump, so the talocrural axis obliquity is unsupported

heel_r.method: area-weighted posterior-most surface band of the sole region (z<3 cm)

hip_r.A_method: thigh axis extended to the level of the inguinal fold (first local minimum of the anterior contour above the crotch)
hip_r.note: femoral head is internal and the source has no trochanteric relief; the inguinal-fold level on the soft-tissue thigh axis and the frozen value are the only alternatives

upperarm_axis_l.method: line through centroids of sections perpendicular to the free upper arm (elbow+3 cm .. armpit contact)

forearm_axis_l.method: line through centroids of forearm sections, 25%..78% wrist->elbow

elbow_l.A_method: centroid of the minimum-area section across the elbow
elbow_l.B_method: centroid of the section at the cubital fossa (most posterior point of the anterior contour)
elbow_l.D_method: closest approach of the upper-arm and forearm axes; diagnostic only (stance flexion 7.0 deg makes it ill-conditioned)

wrist_l.A_method: v005 hand-construction frame origin (copied construction coordinate)
wrist_l.B_method: centroid of the minimum-area distal-forearm section proximal of the hand

glenohumeral_l.A_method: least-squares sphere on the lateral/superior shoulder cap (faces within 9 cm of the measured acromion, normals lateral or up)
glenohumeral_l.B_method: least-squares sphere on the lateral deltoid only (faces within 11 cm of the acromion, 1..12 cm below it, normal lateral > 0.7)

sternoclavicular_l.method: anterior surface summit beside the jugular notch at the frozen SC height (joint depth behind it unresolved)

upperarm_axis_r.method: line through centroids of sections perpendicular to the free upper arm (elbow+3 cm .. armpit contact)

forearm_axis_r.method: line through centroids of forearm sections, 25%..78% wrist->elbow

elbow_r.A_method: centroid of the minimum-area section across the elbow
elbow_r.B_method: centroid of the section at the cubital fossa (most posterior point of the anterior contour)
elbow_r.D_method: closest approach of the upper-arm and forearm axes; diagnostic only (stance flexion 15.7 deg makes it ill-conditioned)

wrist_r.A_method: v005 hand-construction frame origin (copied construction coordinate)
wrist_r.B_method: centroid of the minimum-area distal-forearm section proximal of the hand

glenohumeral_r.A_method: least-squares sphere on the lateral/superior shoulder cap (faces within 9 cm of the measured acromion, normals lateral or up)
glenohumeral_r.B_method: least-squares sphere on the lateral deltoid only (faces within 11 cm of the acromion, 1..12 cm below it, normal lateral > 0.7)

sternoclavicular_r.method: anterior surface summit beside the jugular notch at the frozen SC height (joint depth behind it unresolved)

head_pivot_alt.method: neck/head horizontal-section centroid at the mean ear-root height

eye_l.B_method: sphere on the anterior-facing eye surface within 1.6 cm

eye_r.B_method: sphere on the anterior-facing eye surface within 1.6 cm

mouth_check.note: a closed sculpted mouth has no inward-facing interior faces behind the lip seam
